newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Two die, many trapped on snow-bound Caucasus road.
newsitem.headline: Two die, many trapped on snow-bound Caucasus road.

text.p: At least two people have died and up to 80 more remain trapped by avalanches along a mountainous highway linking southern Russia and Georgia, Russian news agencies said on Saturday.
Heavy snowfall hampered rescue work and many motorists stuck in a tunnel along the highway refused to leave their cars for fear they would be stolen or looted, they said.
Some 50 people, mostly women, had been evacuated from the tunnel and food and medical supplies were being delivered to those remaining, Interfax news agency said.
One woman successfully gave birth while trapped in the tunnel, Itar-Tass news agency reported.
The tunnel is part of a 3,000-metre (10,000-foot) high pass crossing the main Caucasus ridge between the Russian region of North Ossetia and the breakaway Georgian province of South Ossetia.
